detail.title: Conceptual Frameworks for Autonomous AI Discovery
detail.summary: AI in science is conceptually categorized into roles: tools, enablers, and the emerging, hypothetical role of an autonomous agent of understanding. While AI shows promise in optimizing processes, true autonomous scientific discovery remains an aspirational capability requiring further characterization.
